candidate_specs.name: apartment_minimal
candidate_specs.formula: log(price) ~ log(area) + bedrooms + bathrooms + parking + comuna + time_effect
candidate_specs.risk: No training yet; validate against canonical_plus_outliers and keep geography optional.

candidate_specs.name: house_minimal_with_missing_land_indicator
candidate_specs.formula: log(price) ~ log(built_area) + land_area_missing + log(land_area when present) + bedrooms + bathrooms + comuna + time_effect
candidate_specs.risk: Land is too sparse for a strict land model; use missing indicator only in a future pilot.

candidate_specs.name: geographic_variant
candidate_specs.formula: minimal model + microzone or reliable coordinates
candidate_specs.risk: Fine geography coverage is the limiting factor.

roadmap.impact: Enables geographic hedonic effects without overusing comuna dummies.
Improves local segmentation and residual diagnostics.
Reduces product mixing in both comparables and future hedonic samples.
